title: “Choose to be Chosen” SCA Shabbat Message by Rabbi Richard Tobias

chapters.title: Ingredients for good choices
chapters.about: Pro versus con, now versus later, me versus them

summary: Rabbi Tobias discusses Parashat Va'era and the question of why the Torah includes the lineage of Moshe Rabbenu before the first seven Makot. He explains that Moshe Rabbenu was a human being whose greatness came from making good choices, and suggests that parents talk to their children during winter break about the three ingredients of making good choices.
questions: Why does the Torah interrupt the story of Parashat Va'era with the lineage of Moshe Rabbenu?
What made Moshe Rabbenu the leader of the Jewish people?
What are the three ingredients for making good choices?
How can parents spend meaningful time with their children during winter break?
